values.note: Camping $20 a night (with or without horses; trail fees extra for horses). The county also lists day use at $5 per standard vehicle and a $50 annual parking pass ($30 seniors 62+); its pages don't say whether campers pay the day-use fee. No resident/non-resident difference.

fees.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/294/Fees-Rates ('Camping | $20 per night', 'Camping With Horses (Does not include trail fees) | $20 per night', 'Day Use | $5/standard size vehicle', 'Annual | $50', 'Senior Annual (62+/ID required) | $30'), read 2026-10-30

sites.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/293/McIntosh-Reserve-Park ('We currently have 50(+) *primitive campsites available throughout the park'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations by phone or in person, daily 9 am-5 pm, 770-830-5879. Cancel at least 14 days before arrival for a refund less a $10 fee; reservations made within 14 days are non-refundable. Campers register with ID and the tag numbers of all vehicles.

note: Carroll County park (1,750 acres, 1046 W McIntosh Cir, Whitesburg) with sweeping frontage on the Chattahoochee River, a favorite of hikers and equestrian riders. Primitive camping, but self-contained RVs, campers and pull-behinds are allowed; generators OK. No one may camp without a vehicle on site. Open ground fits a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm $20/night, 50(+) primitive sites with no hookups/water/power, self-contained RVs/campers/pull-behinds allowed (so not tent-only), no dump, 5-night max, reservations by phone or in person (770-830-5879, the stored phone). Booking platform set to phone; site count 50 added. No campground season is stated (only park hours). Note: acreage corrected 527+ -> 1,750 and booking/fee facts trimmed. Pin is in the river.
